meta.name: dbt-write
meta.description: Loaded at Step 2 for the full workflow. Covers column naming, type preservation, JOIN defaults, lookup joins, sibling models, materialization, packages, and filtering rules.

copy.tagline: 编写并管理 dbt 数据转换模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 dbt 做数据转换，需要规范模型编写
copy.tagline_en: Write and manage dbt data transformation models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use dbt for data transformation and need to standardize model writing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude在编写dbt模型时会自动应用列名精确匹配、类型保留、聚合先聚合后四舍五入、哈希键正确生成、兄弟模型模式复制、查找连接、默认LEFT JOIN以及不添加未明确要求的过滤等规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求Claude编写或修改dbt模型，特别是在步骤2加载后，涉及列命名、类型、JOIN、聚合、粒度等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个dbt模型的列别名是否匹配YML。
say.note: Claude会验证SQL中的别名与YML完全一致。

say.text: 这个聚合是先SUM再ROUND还是先ROUND再SUM？
say.note: Claude会确保先聚合后四舍五入。

say.text: 这个模型应该从哪个表驱动？检查兄弟模型。
say.note: Claude会读取同目录下兄弟模型的模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies strict rules when writing dbt models: exact column name matching, type preservation, aggregate-then-round, correct hash key generation, sibling model pattern replication, lookup joins, LEFT JOIN defaults, and no filters unless explicitly required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to write or modify dbt models, especially after Step 2 loading, involving column naming, types, JOINs, aggregations, grain, etc.

say_en.text: Check if this dbt model's column aliases match the YML.
say_en.note: Claude verifies SQL aliases match YML exactly.

say_en.text: Is this aggregation SUM then ROUND or ROUND then SUM?
say_en.note: Claude ensures aggregate first, then round.

say_en.text: Which table should drive this model? Check sibling models.
say_en.note: Claude reads sibling models in the same directory for patterns.
